errors.text_span: 最高点约为5000，落在2022年3月上旬左右
errors.evidence: The highest point of the blue line (news reports) is ~5,000, but it occurs in late July/early August 2022, not March.
The bars are described as 蓝绿色 (blue-green) in the atom checklist, not 浅蓝色 (light blue).
The description omits the left y-axis label (每日新增确诊人数) and its range (0–1,800,000).
The description omits the right y-axis label (相关新闻媒体每日报道数量) and its range (0–6,000).
The description does not specify the x-axis range as 近两个月 (nearly two months) with weekly intervals.
The description does not explicitly mention the synchronization or lag in trends between cases and news reports.
The description does not mention the difference in peak timing (e.g., lag effect) between cases and news reports.
The x-axis labels in the figure start from 2022年7月1日, not January.
The phrase 事件数量 is ambiguous; it does not clarify whether it refers to cases or news reports.
